jobs.title: Business Intelligence Analyst
jobs.content: <div><strong>About Harborpay</strong><br>Harborpay is a global, fast-growing fintech scale-up that builds payment tooling for imaginary marketplaces.<br>We ship small changes every day and review each other's work in the open. Offices are optional, and most colleagues work from home a few days per week. Our engineering group is split into compact teams that own a service from design to operation. The company was founded by a handful of friends who disliked slow, noisy tooling.</div><p><strong>The role</strong></p><p>You will take part in on-call rotations and help the team keep alerts quiet and useful. You will help migrate older modules to the new platform without downtime. You will own the quality of your changes from the first commit to the production dashboard.</p><p><strong>What we look for</strong></p><ul><li>Habit of writing small pull requests with clear descriptions</li><li>Comfort with HTTP APIs, queues and background jobs</li><li>Several years of professional experience building backend services</li><li>Good command of one mainstream language and its testing tools</li></ul><p><strong>What we offer</strong></p><ul><li>Flexible working hours and a home-office budget</li><li>Private health insurance for you and your family</li><li>Equal opportunity: we welcome people of every background</li></ul>
